title: Named esym.Real in the parameters of the user items, kept beside the numbers of the items and used by the symbolic system
author: Claude-JG
description: The parameters of a user item given as numbers and named esym.Real (a mass m1 = esym.Real('m1', 5.)), so that the expressions keep the names and a variable shared by several items is one variable, and parts of the equations can be differentiated by them. Checked: the C++ item stores numbers and refuses esym.Real, so the item gets the values and UserItemCreator (and a helper for items made directly) keeps the variables; the recording of a kind keeps parameters as its argument; SymbolicSystem.Equations passes the variables as the parameters of each item, the flat program lists them as arguments, Diff by them works; changed values reach the items by an explicit call. Design symbolicSystem.md section 12.7.
releaseNotes: the parameters of user items as named exudyn.symbolic.Real: UserItemCreator.CreateMassPoint(mass=m1) and the spring-dampers give the item the value and keep the variable in parameterVariables; SymbolicSystem(mbs, parameters=...) keeps the variables in Equations(), its export takes them as arguments, so the derivatives by them follow; SetParameterValues sets the variables and the items
